title: CloudWatch Logs: log groups, retention, Insights and metric filters

videos.script: A metric says the shop is slow. It does not say why. The why is in the logs. {{why}} Logs cost money twice. Once when they arrive, and every month after, for as long as nobody sets a retention. And nobody does, because a new log group keeps everything for ever. {{cost}} This lesson writes the shop's logs as JSON lines, each a small record you can ask questions of. Which paths fail? How slow is checkout? Is one customer behind it? {{questions}} moto stores the lines and runs no query. So the lesson asks the same questions with jq, and shows the Logs Insights query AWS would run. {{jq}} Then it turns lines into a number an alarm can watch, and names the danger. A metric made from a log line goes blind when somebody deletes that line. {{filter}} By the end, every log group you own has a retention, and an answer is one query away. {{end}}
